title: RAW whole f17r final paragraph: actual graft case versus method licence and graft-specific product
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Retain the complete23-value graft account and both seasonal attachments. The entire immediate successor must connect any actual named graft, season/refusal and product to the same stock/donor case. Refusal of that graft does not imply stock sterility, and absence of refusal does not entail a product. A written actual summer split case could distinguish the two old scope accounts; an invented scenario cannot.
phase: bounded exploratory proposal; no target test or new meaning confirmed
access: Existing primary meaning contracts and metadata only for newly nominated adjoining units. No raw target census, new image, reserve, source download, contact, semantic execution or code. All hypotheses are previously exposed or newly proposed exploration, not holdout confirmation.
claim_ceiling: A successful complete draft could supply a constrained working reading and a written consequence; it would not prove any word, source identity or historical meaning. No experiment may start before a full exact draft and separate review.

target.selection_reason: Immediate whole successor of fixed f17r.4–6; no word-based rank or fallback.
target.missing_reader_rule: An empty RF1b array is NO_WHOLE_READER in this cache. It is not permission to fabricate paragraph boundaries or import another edition’s groups. If a complete owned corresponding line union is later found, retain its native boundary status separately.

fixed_inputs.all_values: All23 exact whole values, all four complete constructions and their participant references unchanged. tcho@154; remains an uncertain whole; IT tcho?, qofcho, chekeg remain unbound unless independently present in a separately declared new proposal, not this one.
fixed_inputs.referents: A stock, B donor, donor shoot S, donor bark/bud T and the particular graft E. shol/cthy and qor/chor retain their original role anaphora. cheteg means product of E, never ordinary fruit of A.
fixed_inputs.rivals: Keep GROUPED and NEAREST seasonal attachments as complete alternatives. The parent is a method account, not three performed grafts. Neither variant asserts actual season, performance, refusal or success.

design.whole_content_offer: The complete next paragraph would instantiate or compare a graft case: which of the previously named methods is used with the same stock/donor, whether that particular union is refused, and which result is attributed to it rather than to the unmodified stock or another graft. The account can instead remain instructions; actual execution versus a licensed option must be expressed by one uniform construction. No named species, successful graft or changed fruit trait is inserted from the historical analogy.
new_written_obligation: A later assertion of PRODUCT_OF(E) and actual refusal of that same E at the relevant event cannot both hold under the old rule. A product of another graft or ordinary stock fruit requires a genuinely different written referent/type; rementioning STOCK does not create one.

An actual or expressly licensed SPLIT_INSERT in summer would be licensed by NEAREST and not licensed by GROUPED within this account. This is a possible literal continuation discriminator only if the complete written paragraph actually binds method and season; no synthetic summer input counts.

A later product of a not-refused graft remains a new positive assertion; it cannot be inferred merely from not refused. A statement of no graft product still does not prohibit ordinary fruit on the stock.
design.capacity_gate: Before assigning unknowns, require at least two distinct exact inherited participant/product/reference forms from {shol,cthy,qor,chor,shor,cho,cheteg,som} and one exact old method/season/guard form from {tsho,qof,qokcheor,cphor,cphaldy,cthey,dair,qody} in this entire nominated unit. This is only a literal reuse gate; forms that resolve the same role do not by themselves establish two independent participants. Report missing capacity without searching a replacement or inventing synonymous entries.

rivals.meaning: The new paragraph concerns the E/A/B roles of the preceding account, with an overt actual-case or comparison construction.
A distinct graft E2, possibly on the same A, is explicitly introduced. Its donor/material must be written; no reset follows merely from a paragraph break.
The full paragraph only comments on licences or possible results, without actual graft or fruit events.

strongest_countercases: The old23 types are all singletons and every proposed value is guessed. Repetition and shared argument constraints in the new entire paragraph, not another seasonal truth table, are needed.
GDT1021 kept both seasonal readings. Columella analogy favors shared spring scope but does not select the manuscript parse.
Palladius permits changed products and refusal examples; no universal donor-trait inheritance or actual success law may be introduced.
The source reading is uncertain and the old IT account incomplete. Completion of a ZL continuation does not repair the parent reader gap.
design.smallest_next_retrieval: Freeze the entire nominated unit before opening its word body. Retain every position and every already-owned alternate reading. After selection, first report exact inherited matches and all unknown forms, then attempt the complete paragraph within the declared caps. A failed coverage/cost gate closes this nomination; no fallback paragraph, source normalization, new aliases or cap increase. Preserve the best full incomplete draft with its exact remaining obligations.
design.outcomes: A whole written case tying old participants, a method and a product can add a real cross-clause obligation and potentially distinguish old seasonal scope. Otherwise retain the exact full incomplete draft; do not report a synthetic product/refusal conflict as a manuscript finding.
